name: std-board
description: std-board — generic N-column board primitive. `config.columns` is an array of column definitions ({ key, label, icon, variant }); the trait `array/map`s them on `BoardItemsLoaded` into `@entity.boards` where each board carries its filtered items + a count. The render is a `data-grid` over `@entity.boards` (one card per column) whose `renderItem` lambda nests a `data-list` over `@col.items` (the cards in that stage). N is config-driven — pass any number of columns; the outer `data-grid`'s `cols` is bound to `@config.gridCols` so the grid wraps if you exceed it. Topology = loading / viewing_board / viewing_card / adding / error — distinct from the cookie-cutter `loading/browsing/viewing_single/error` CRUD shape. App-level atoms (e.g. std-pipeline) compose std-board via `uses` and add a sibling persistor + extended source entity. `config.boardLook` switches the board body between the default N-column grid ('columns') and a Trello-style wide-column kanban ('kanban-classic'). `viewing_board` listens for REFETCH_QUERY/REFETCH_FILTER/REFETCH_PAGE (the std-search/std-filter/std-pagination wiring targets, no render on refetch — @entity.boards is bound reactively) and can optionally render its own search box (config.bodySearch, default false) and filter bar (config.filters, default []); no pagination control is rendered — a board's columns are not a paged list.

kanbanClassicBodyContent.label: Kanban classic body content tree
kanbanClassicBodyContent.description: Render-ui SExpr for boardLook='kanban-classic' — Trello-style wide elevated columns with sticky headers, dense cards with a status badge; per-item cards honor config.cardLook (the column wrapper stays elevated — it is column chrome, not a card).

cardIdBinding.label: Card id binding
cardIdBinding.description: Per-card binding for the id used in action payloads.

filterBarLook.label: Filter bar look
filterBarLook.description: Visual treatment for the embedded filter bar, mirroring std-filter's own enum. Only applies when `filters` is non-empty.
filterBarLook.synonyms: filter bar style, facet style, chips, pills

formFields.label: New-card fields
formFields.description: Fields shown in the add-card form

cardLook.label: Card look
cardLook.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for cards rendered by this board.

cardStageBinding.label: Card stage binding
cardStageBinding.description: Per-card binding for the stage/status slot.

filters.label: Which filters should appear above the board?
filters.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the columns; each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait. Empty (the default) = no filter bar, which is the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this board and routes its FILTER event to REFETCH_FILTER — that is the wired owner and remains the primary path. Use this knob only for a standalone board with no page-level filter affordance.
filters.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, column filters, dropdowns

groupByField.label: Group-by field
groupByField.description: Entity field whose value matches a column key — items are filtered into columns by it. Default 'stage'; set to 'status' (or any field) for entities that track state under a different name.

bodyContent.label: Body content tree
bodyContent.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the board loads for boardLook='columns' — the canonical column data-grid with nested per-column data-lists. boardLook='kanban-classic' renders kanbanClassicBodyContent instead; both share this trait's state machine, emits, and listens.

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Board columns; each row's stage maps to a column key

searchPlaceholder.label: Search box placeholder text
searchPlaceholder.description: Hint text inside the board's embedded search box (e.g. 'Search cards…'). Only shown when bodySearch is true.
searchPlaceholder.synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text, search label

gridCols.label: Grid columns
gridCols.description: Outer grid column count before the board wraps

pageSize.label: Fetch page size
pageSize.description: Records fetched per REFETCH_PAGE request. std-board renders no pagination control itself — this only feeds the fetch limit/offset when a consumer wires a composed std-pagination to REFETCH_PAGE.
pageSize.synonyms: fetch limit, records per page, batch size, page limit

cardActionsContent.label: Card panel actions
cardActionsContent.description: Actions row of the open-card panel. Default is the Delete button only. Override to add consumer-wired actions — e.g. an Edit button with action: EDIT_CARD and actionPayload: { id: @entity.currentId, row: @entity.currentRow }, listened to by the organism's edit modal. Never leave a button here without a listener.

cardTitleBinding.label: Card title binding
cardTitleBinding.description: Per-card binding for the title slot.

bodySearch.label: Show the board's own search box?
bodySearch.description: Renders an inline search box above the columns. Defaults false: unlike std-browse, std-board has never had a search box, so defaulting this true would silently add one to every existing consumer. The wired path — composing std-search beside the board and routing its FILTER/SEARCH event to REFETCH_QUERY — works regardless of this knob; set true only for a standalone board with no page-level search affordance.
bodySearch.synonyms: inline search, board search, built-in search, show search, duplicate search

boardLook.label: Board look
boardLook.description: Layer 3 body layout: default N-column data-grid ('columns'), or a Trello-style wide-column kanban with sticky column headers ('kanban-classic').
